name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
accessNote: Spiritual creatures in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon are in level 28-32 Wilderness; do not bring items you are unwilling to lose. The task page marks Spiritual rangers, warriors, and mages here as safespottable and cannon-immune. Bring one Armadyl or Bandos item depending on entrance, one Saradomin item, and one Zamorak item for follower tolerance.
